headline: South Africa Plans Direct FinTech Access to National Payment Network
summary: South Africa plans to let regulated fintechs access its payment network directly, reducing their reliance on traditional banks.
why: Traditional banks have long maintained a grip on payment processing fees; opening the network could increase competition and lower transaction costs for merchants and consumers.

impacts.name: South African Banking
impacts.why: Direct network access for fintechs threatens to compress fee income for traditional South African retail banks.
